_comment: Ignition scenarios: hypothetical ignitions, not detected fires.
Nothing here was observed by anyone. Each entry is a coordinate we ask
Deepfire to simulate a single-point ignition from, which is why there is
no detection time and no containment status -- see CONTEXT.md.
Deepfire only simulates continental US, Europe and Hawaii, and an
ignition on fuel that does not carry fire (cropland, bare rock, urban
core) returns a valid forecast that simply does not grow. Pick points on
Editing this file changes the scenario list on the next restart. A
scenario whose id already has a bundle under data/bundles/ keeps that
bundle: change the id to force a fresh simulation.

scenarios.name: La Jonquera
scenarios.description: Alt Emporda, near the border. Wind-exposed cork oak and scrub; the corridor the 2012 fire ran through.

scenarios.name: La Segarra
